title: Which of these five numbers is divisible by nine?
description: Five numbers are tested for divisibility by nine without dividing, by adding the digits of each and comparing the digit sum with the multiples of nine.
teaching_notes: One idea: a number is divisible by nine exactly when its digit sum is divisible by nine, so list the multiples of nine and see where the digit sum falls. Watch for students who stop when the digit sum is close to a multiple of nine, or who test only the units digit.

source: Figure it Out (multiples of nine, question 1)
video_script.why: The student can find a remainder on division by nine from the digit sum and now uses the digit sum to test five numbers.
video_script.substitution: Add the digits of each number and compare the digit sum with the multiples of nine.
video_script.anchor: the digits of each number added in a row, with the digit sum placed on a strip of multiples of nine
video_script.payoff_line: Only four hundred five is divisible by nine

final_answer.spoken: only four hundred five is divisible by nine

maths_rules: a number is divisible by 9 exactly when its digit sum is divisible by 9
8888: 8 + 8 + 8 + 8 = 32, between 27 and 36, not a multiple of 9
93547: 9 + 3 + 5 + 4 + 7 = 28, one more than 27, not a multiple of 9
358095: 3 + 5 + 8 + 0 + 9 + 5 = 30, between 27 and 36, not a multiple of 9
video_script.design: Each number's digits are added in a row and the digit sum is placed on a strip of multiples of nine. Only 405 lands on a multiple of nine.

marks.rule: the rule a number is divisible by nine when its digit sum is, is written

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Step one, a number is divisible by nine when its digit sum is divisible by nine.
<bookmark mark='mult'/>The multiples of nine are nine, eighteen, twenty seven, thirty six and so on.

marks.first: the digits of one hundred twenty three are added to six
marks.six: six is placed on the strip and does not land on a multiple of nine
marks.five: the digits of four hundred five are added to nine
marks.nine: nine is placed on the strip and lands on a multiple of nine

narration: <bookmark mark='first'/>Step two, one hundred twenty three has digit sum one plus two plus three, which is six.
<bookmark mark='six'/>Six is not a multiple of nine.
<bookmark mark='five'/>Four hundred five has digit sum four plus zero plus five, which is nine.
<bookmark mark='nine'/>Nine is a multiple of nine.

marks.eights: the digits of eight thousand eight hundred eighty eight are added to thirty two
marks.between: thirty two is placed on the strip between twenty seven and thirty six
marks.ninety: the digits of ninety three thousand five hundred forty seven are added to twenty eight
marks.one: twenty eight is placed on the strip one after twenty seven

narration: <bookmark mark='eights'/>Step three, eight thousand eight hundred eighty eight has four eights, so its digit sum is thirty two.
<bookmark mark='between'/>Thirty two lies between twenty seven and thirty six, so it is not a multiple of nine.
<bookmark mark='ninety'/>Next, ninety three thousand five hundred forty seven has digit sum twenty eight.
<bookmark mark='one'/>Twenty eight is one more than twenty seven, so it is not a multiple of nine.

marks.last: the digits of three hundred fifty eight thousand ninety five are added to thirty
marks.between: thirty is placed on the strip between twenty seven and thirty six

narration: <bookmark mark='last'/>Step four, three hundred fifty eight thousand ninety five has digit sum thirty.
<bookmark mark='between'/>Thirty lies between twenty seven and thirty six, so it is not a multiple of nine.

marks.check: four hundred five is split into forty five groups of nine

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>Step five, check four hundred five. It is nine times forty five, so nine divides it exactly.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Only four hundred five is divisible by nine.
